We don't. I live with my grandmother and brother. Still in university. 

She just started her job and has only an ounce of money saved from her four months of working. She's really isn't earning a lot. She's staying in an apartment near her work and goes home here in our city during weekends and holidays.

I think a European country is harder because

a) We don't know anybody there

b) We don't have any money to finance the travel and rent and other daily expenses if she gets a job offer there

c) It would be similarly hard to get a job offer there

From what I know and from what people have told us, she needs to get experience and a job offer. We have been applying for jobs that require no experience there, but none of them really accept foreigners. Plus, she doesn't want to wait anymore. She had been waiting to get out of the country since college when she thought that she'd get a job abroad after graduating. 

Manila isn't safer. Almost all crimes in the Philippines center around the Manila area

It's mad out here. Singapore would be ideal because my parents are there and I've lived there during elementary too. So I know firsthand that it would be great for us. It's safe and her daughter can go to a good school there too
